comments.author: dragontamer
comments.why_zh: 关于火控计算机凸轮-圆柱机构的细节
comments.quote_zh: 这里专门讲到了圆柱机构（2x 输入映射到 1x 输出）
comments.text_zh: 我对 slide-rule 已经了解有一阵子了。但我之前没意识到的是，slide-rule 的机械原理被用在了二战时期战列舰的火控计算机上。[LINK] 这些计算机有类似 slide-rule 的圆柱体，会旋转。当你把火炮瞄准具“对准”目标时，火炮的坐标会被映射到一个圆柱体上，而圆柱体会让火炮朝另一个方向移动（目标越远，你就必须把火炮瞄得“更高”，以补偿重力使炮弹“下坠”）。实际上，火控计算机内部那个形状古怪的圆柱体就是一个预先算好的解，把 x/y 坐标输入映射为 z 坐标输出（这里的“z”会被送入火炮原始的瞄准系统）。火炮的不同参数通过齿轮和曲柄编程进去，物理地移动圆柱体。更多细节见：[VIDEO]。这是一个 20 分钟的视频。圆柱机构（2x 输入映射到 1x 输出）在这里有专门讲到：[VIDEO]。精心制作的圆柱体可以是任何预先算好的 2 输入/1 输出函数。--------- 机械计算机很好玩。slide rule 不过是最简单的一种。就在几十年前，在现代数字计算机出现之前，人们还在把更复杂的“机械计算机”用于非常严肃的作战/测距/等系统。
comments.text: So I've known about slide-rules for a while. What I didn't realize was that the mechanical principles of slide-rules were applied to fire-control computers on WW2-era Battleships. [LINK] These computers had slide-rule like cylinders that would rotate. As you aimed the gun sights "at" a target, the gun's coordinates were being mapped to a cylinder, which would move the gun a different direction (you have to aim the gun "higher" the further away the target is, to account for gravity "drooping" the bullet). In effect; the weirdly shaped cylinder inside the fire-control computer is a pre-computed solution that maps x/y coordinate inputs to a z-coordinate output (where "z" would be fed into the gun's raw aiming system). The different parameters of the gun were programmed in with gears and cranks, moving the cylinder around physically. For more details, see: [VIDEO] Its a 20-minute video. The cylinder mechanism (of 2x inputs mapped to 1x output) is specifically talked about here: [VIDEO] . Carefully crafted cylinders could be any pre-computed 2-input / 1-output function. --------- Mechanical computers are fun. Slide rules are but the simplest kind. People were using more complicated "mechanical computers" for very serious combat / rangefinding / etc. systems just a few decades ago, before the advent of modern digital computers.

comments.text: From top of head I really enjoy: MAPMAKING PROCESS, THE [LINK] mechanism computer of fire control computer (a classic) [VIDEO] Physical science documentary series whose exact title I can't recall. It has been a while. To find more, my method is to do the occasional PeriscopeFilm binge (on youtube that digitizes a lot of old media, with great descriptions), always find find something interesting I haven't watched. If style, delivery really good, there's usually something in description to point to more. Like "U.S. NAVY TRAINING FILM", which usually returns playlists, and videos in same era often share quality. The technical ones generally don't disappoint. Another one is The Best Film Archives with good military training playlists. Tangent for others: the one I wish to remember, is a deleted/banned channel, one of the original US archival footage channel, with I think 1000s of videos, that got wiped many years ago right when youtube started drm crackdown. It had a companion website with obsessive amount of detail and tags to find the perfect video. And from what I recall, it didn't feel like a business like periscopefilm, but a passion project. It was an incredible amount of work to have been wiped out.

comments.text_zh: 专用计算机是任何在给定某些输入或初始条件后，针对某个特定问题计算答案的设备。算盘或计算尺不是计算机，因为它们不是为某个特定问题或题目设计的（当然，它们可以辅助计算）。对于 Antikythera mechanism，操作者把机器设到当前日期，然后转动曲柄来推进日期。表盘会持续显示几颗行星的位置、月相、日月食，可能还有一两种其他东西。Charles Babbage 的 Difference Engine 计算多项式的值。操作者会设定多项式的系数，然后转动曲柄，针对连续的 X 值计算该多项式的连续值。不过他从未完成它。二战驱逐舰上的火控计算机根据编码了本舰位置和速度、目标位置和速度以及其他若干变量的输入，计算火炮的正确仰角。[VIDEO] 通用计算机把一段 _program_ 作为输入，而程序指定要解决的问题。你可以这一分钟加载一个计算日月食的程序，下一分钟加载一个计算多项式或射击解的程序，或者加载一个检查电子邮件的程序。硬件没有变，只有程序和输入变了。对比一下 Difference Engine：要让 Difference Engine 计算日月食或
comments.text: A special–purpose computer is any device which computes an answer to a specific question given some input or initial conditions. An abacus or slide rule is not a computer because they are not designed for a specific question or problem (but they can of course be an aid to computation). With the Antikythera mechanism, the operator sets the machine to the current date, and then turns the crank to advance the date. The dials on the face would continuously show the positions of several planets, the phase of the moon, the eclipses, and possibly one or two other things. Charles Babbage’s Difference Engine computed the values of polynomials. The operator would set the coefficients of the polynomial, then turn the crank to compute successive values of that polynomial for successive values of X. He never finished it though. The firing computer on a WWII destroyer computed the correct elevation of the guns, based on inputs that encoded the position and velocity of the ship, the position and velocity of the target, and several other variables. [VIDEO] General–purpose computers take as input a _program_, and the program specifies the problem to be solved. You could load a program for computing eclipses one minute, and the next minute load a program for computing polynomials or firing solutions, or load one to check your email.
